_source: Lucid Trading — LucidFlex evaluation, 25K. Rules read 2026-10-29; confirm on your dashboard after any firm update.

drawdown.basis: end-of-day balance high-water mark — intraday excursions do not count

consistency.applies_to: evaluation only; the rule is dropped once funded
consistency.formula: largest single day profit / account profit must be at or below the limit

desk.why: 1% of equity = $250 is the smallest budget that still fits one MES ($209) or MCL ($223) stop — there is no smaller contract, so size cannot shrink further. One position at a time because two concurrent micro stops are 42% of a $1,000 buffer. The buffer guard refuses new risk unless two stops of room remain, so a loss never eats the last one; the self-imposed $400 daily stop ends a two-loss day.
